frontend_tasks.action: Confirm the deployed site at www.dionleung.engineer is built from portfolio-nodemailer ContactForm.js before editing. Line numbers match the working tree observed on 2026-10-20.

Replace the subjectLine hidden input with one text input named company. Keep it in the DOM as type=text. Position the wrapper off-screen (for example position absolute and left -10000px). Set tabIndex to -1, autoComplete to off, and aria-hidden on the wrapper. Do not use type=hidden or display:none. Leave the subject select untouched.

Read company from the input DOM value at submit time with a ref or an uncontrolled input. A script can set the DOM value without firing React onChange, and React state would stay empty. Use that same DOM string for both the abort decision and the JSON field.

Add company to contactFormFilled. Humans and untouched forms must send company as "". Remove subjectLine from the payload. If the old input remains for any reason, include its DOM value too: a non-empty subjectLine is dropped by the handler with HTTP 200 and no mail.

Skip API.submitEmail when the company DOM value is non-empty. window.location.reload() can stay as a secondary behavior. This abort is required because a filled trap receives HTTP 200 completed, which the current .then() treats as success.

After this form change, a bot that posts company as an empty string and never fills the text input still reaches sendMail. That is the remaining hole. A later backend change would add a rate limit or a server-checked token. Do not invent that token in the form until the handler verifies it.
